public_rationale: OpenAI reported capability improvements from scaling GPT-4.5 on February 27, 2025, but did not establish whether gains per proportional increase in training compute had declined [e5]. Epoch's retrospective analysis, available September 16, 2025, found GPT-4.5's gains on GPQA and Math Level 5 consistent with historical compute-scaling trends [e6]. This weighs against declining returns on those benchmarks, but these items do not provide the representative, controlled longitudinal comparison needed to settle the broader February 2025 claim [e5, e6].
limitations: The evidence does not isolate pretraining scale from changes in data, architecture, and post-training across representative capabilities.
The claim specifies neither an effectiveness metric nor an earlier comparison period.
The exact date of the February statement is unknown; the February 27 release cannot establish what was observable when it was made.
